uncertainty_summary: Footprint/position are strong at roof-perimeter level, with very close independent aerial overlay. Structural wall offsets are not directly surveyed.
Height is estimated from a six-level reading of the KJG rendering (ground retail plus five residential floors) and secondary listing. Other sources say five stories; exact story count is unresolved.
Flat roof is strongly supported by aerial and rendering; roof edge parapet dimensions are schematic.
Facade architecture is supported as design intent, not verified as-built; use as representative visual massing only.
